# PositronicKit documentation

> Stable 6.0.0 is the default, immutable channel. Next / v5 follows main and is unreleased.

## Stable

- [Overview and quick start](https://github.com/phynics/PositronicKit/blob/6.0.0/README.md): Stable package setup, provider configuration, examples, and verification.
- [Setup](https://github.com/phynics/PositronicKit/blob/6.0.0/docs/Setup.md): Stable provider, persistence, customization, logging, and error setup.
- [Usage](https://github.com/phynics/PositronicKit/blob/6.0.0/docs/Usage.md): Stable runtime, Agent lifecycle, Workspace routing, and embeddings usage.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/phynics/PositronicKit/blob/6.0.0/docs/Architecture.md): Architecture and module boundaries shipped by the stable release.
- [Prompt composition](https://github.com/phynics/PositronicKit/blob/6.0.0/docs/PKPromptComposition.md): Stable prompt composition, rendering, compression, and journaling APIs.
- [Sidecar directives](https://github.com/phynics/PositronicKit/blob/6.0.0/docs/SidecarDirectives.md): Stable auxiliary structured-result behavior.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/phynics/PositronicKit/blob/6.0.0/CHANGELOG.md): Published release history through this immutable tag.

## Next / v5

- [Overview and quick start](README.md): Release selection, runtime contracts, Timeline history, provider setup, typed structured generation, conformance suites, runnable examples, products, and verification.
- [Setup](docs/Setup.md): Provider-neutral configuration, readiness and health, stream timing, offline examples, persistence, customization, logging, and stable error identity.
- [Usage](docs/Usage.md): Managed and direct Turns, durable Timeline history, typed and raw one-shot structured generation, cancellation, SOUL/Notes Agent memory, lifecycle, and Workspace routing.
- [Architecture](docs/Architecture.md): v5 domain boundaries, capability values, durability, and execution authority.
- [Prompt composition](docs/PKPromptComposition.md): Prompt IR, assembly, rendering, compression, and PromptJournal.
- [Sidecar directives](docs/SidecarDirectives.md): Auxiliary structured results carried by the same Turn.
- [Development](docs/Development.md): Supported platform gates, container workflow, Linux coverage reports, and dependency checks.
- [Testing](docs/Testing.md): Test targets, layers, tagging taxonomy, determinism rules, and gate-script policy.
- [Context map](CONTEXT-MAP.md): Canonical Timeline, Turn, Agent, Workspace, prompt, and contract vocabulary.
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/): Accepted runtime architecture decisions and their trade-offs.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Published release deltas and the unreleased Next change set.
